entities.summary: Gustave de Molinari was a Belgian political economist and French Liberal School theorist associated with French laissez-faire economists such as Frédéric Bastiat and Hippolyte Castille. Gustave de Molinari was a performers & entertainers from Liège (1819-03-03, Liège–1912-01-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
